headline: Weathered Expanse Remains War’s Busiest Front
war_summary: Since the last edition, the heaviest movement remains in WeatheredExpanseHex, where forty-five ownership events stand in the past day, ten within six hours and four within the latest two. Casualty rates have surged again on both sides, and the sector now holds two Warden, five Colonial, and two neutral strategic bases. StlicanShelfHex has also come alive at the wire, adding two events in the latest two hours and eleven across the day; its present ledger shows three Warden, five Colonial, and one neutral base. CallahansPassageHex likewise records two fresh events, bringing its daily count to six, with fighting and enlistments accelerating over the two-hour comparison. MooringCountyHex remains a large but quieter front: seventeen daily events, none in the latest six hours, after a sharp earlier struggle, and eleven Warden bases against one Colonial. PalantineBermHex retains eleven daily events but no fresh movement in the latest windows. Elsewhere, LinnMercyHex has three older daily events, while most sectors show no recent strategic-base change.
